title: Move to another server
unavailable: This deployment has no upgrade mechanism, so it cannot move itself.
loadFailed: Could not read the relocation status.

warning.secrets: The archive holds the encryption key together with the whole database, so anyone who has it can read every stored credential — delete every copy once the move is done.
warning.ssh: Yagra opens an SSH session to the server you name and acts there, using sudo to install Docker; the password or key you type is used for this run only and never stored.

readiness.unsupported: This deployment has no updater container, so it cannot move itself — take an archive by hand as DEPLOYMENT.md describes.
readiness.absent: The updater container is not reporting: it was removed, or the stack is still starting.
readiness.stopped: The updater container has stopped reporting. Check its logs alongside core.
readiness.paused: Moving uses the WebUI upgrade mechanism, which is switched off here — turn it on in <lnk/>.
readiness.updater_too_old: This updater predates relocation — upgrade once in <lnk/> and this page will work.

space.tight: There may not be enough room. Free some space before starting, or untick what you do not need to carry.

partial.info: Covers the database and the metrics. Events, flows and images are measured when the run starts, and the run stops if they do not fit.

carried.heading: What moves
carried.again: Decide again on the new server

yesItem.1: The encryption key, and the session and bus keys beside it
yesItem.2: The whole database — nodes, groups, thresholds, users, alert history, the audit log
yesItem.3: The metrics, if you leave that ticked
yesItem.4: Events and flows, if you leave that ticked
yesItem.5: This deployment's .env and composition, including any local changes
yesItem.6: The exact version this server is running

noItem.1: Redis — it is a mirror of what the database already holds
noItem.2: The certificate files on disk — they are rebuilt from the database rows on first start
noItem.3: Core's rotated log files and the poller's send buffer

againItem.1: The bus certificate names this host's addresses; remote pollers need it reissued if the new address differs
againItem.2: OIDC redirect URIs point at this host
againItem.3: Devices sending syslog, traps or flow records point at this host
againItem.4: The WebUI's certificate is this host's, so a browser will warn until it is replaced
againItem.5: The firewall on the new server has to allow the WebUI port

options.tier2Hint: Pauses event and flow recording briefly
options.imagesHint: About 1 GB, for a private or unreachable registry
options.installDocker: Install Docker if it is missing

invalid.badHost: The host must be a host name or an IP address.
invalid.badPort: The port must be a number between 1 and 65535.
invalid.badUser: The account must be a Linux user name — lower case, starting with a letter or underscore.
invalid.badDir: The directory must be a plain name, not a path.
invalid.noSecret: A password or a private key is needed to sign in to that server.

run.heading: Progress
run.starting: Waiting for the updater to pick this up…

stage.backup: Backing up the database and the key
stage.files: Collecting the settings and the composition
stage.push: Sending it and restoring it there

done.pushed: The new server is up at {{url}}.
done.archived: The archive is ready to download.
done.dockerInstalled: Docker was installed on that server.

afterwards.heading: Before you call this done
afterwards.item1: Stop this server — both are polling now, and both will notify:
afterwards.item2: If you run remote-site pollers and the new address differs, reissue the bus certificate in <lnk/> there and hand out the site bundles again.
afterwards.item3: Update the OIDC redirect URIs in <lnk/> there.
afterwards.item4: Repoint any device sending syslog, traps or flow records at this host's address.
afterwards.item5: Open the WebUI port in the new server's firewall, if it has one.

manual.heading: Or carry it over yourself
manual.waiting: An archive is waiting on this host. It holds the encryption key and every stored credential — download it, move it, and delete it from here.
manual.deleteBody: The archive holds the encryption key and every stored credential. Deleting it here does not affect any copy you have already downloaded.

steps.title: Restore it on the new server
steps.s1: Put the archive in your home directory there. Docker must be installed.
